comparison.objective: Sample air inside a utility handhole, then conditionally remove bolts only if no alarm occurs.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert and dwell a sampling hose, inspect a monitor, and perform conditional bolt manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: A continuous 60 s sample precedes either safe bolt removal or alarm-responsive nonintervention; premature loosening fails.
comparison.reason: This tests long-dwell sensing, conditional decision-making, and threaded fastener removal—not physical mixture separation.
